build_fconv_model: build a fully convolutional encoder-decoder model using FConvModel.build_model with args and task
build_fconv_encoder: build a convolutional encoder with FConvEncoder using specified convolutions, embed_dim, and dropout
build_fconv_decoder: build a convolutional decoder with FConvDecoder using linearized convolutions and optional attention layers
configure_fconv_architecture: configure an fconv model architecture using base_architecture or named variants like fconv_wmt_en_de
review_attention_layer: review the AttentionLayer class for encoder-decoder attention with in/out projections and beamable MM support
